**Analyzing PowerShell Cmdlets**

I'm thinking through using PowerShell commands. When I try `cat .claude/plugins/marketplaces/ | ls`, I expect it might either return "Access to path is denied" or show some DirectoryInfo. The idea of piping to `Get-ChildItem` makes sense, but I’m not totally sure if `ls` will work correctly with that input. I realize that `Get-Content` can't read a directory, which could lead to an error. I need to figure this out better!
